mapper.select: SELECT instance, organization_id, access_token FROM yunxiao_connection WHERE id = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO yunxiao_connection (id, instance, organization_id, access_token) VALUES (1, #{instance}, #{organizationId}, #{accessToken}) ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET instance = excluded.instance, organization_id = excluded.organization_id, access_token = excluded.access_token
mapper.select: SELECT member_id, name FROM yunxiao_assignee_preference WHERE scope = #{scope} AND member_id <> ''
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO yunxiao_assignee_preference (scope, member_id, name) VALUES (#{scope}, #{assignee.memberId}, #{assignee.name}) ON CONFLICT (scope) DO UPDATE SET member_id = excluded.member_id, name = excluded.name
mapper.select: SELECT task_id, scope, child_id, label FROM yunxiao_binding
SELECT scope, child_id, label FROM yunxiao_binding WHERE task_id = #{taskId}

SELECT b.scope, b.child_id, b.label FROM yunxiao_binding b WHERE b.scope = #{scope} ORDER BY MAX( COALESCE((SELECT MAX(SUBSTR(w.operation, -10)) FROM yunxiao_write w WHERE w.task_id = b.task_id AND w.scope = b.scope AND w.remote_id <> '' AND w.operation GLOB ('effort:' || b.child_id || ':????-??-??')), ''), COALESCE((SELECT DATE(MAX(s.started_at), 'unixepoch') FROM work_session s WHERE s.task_id = b.task_id), '') ) DESC, b.task_id DESC

SELECT b.scope, b.child_id, b.label FROM yunxiao_binding b JOIN yunxiao_write w ON w.task_id = b.task_id AND w.scope = b.scope WHERE b.scope = #{scope} AND w.operation = 'effort:' || b.child_id || ':' || #{day} AND w.remote_id <> '' ORDER BY b.task_id
SELECT rows_json FROM yunxiao_quick_effort_draft WHERE scope = #{scope} AND day = #{day}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO yunxiao_quick_effort_draft (scope, day, rows_json) VALUES (#{scope}, #{day}, #{rows}) ON CONFLICT (scope, day) DO UPDATE SET rows_json = excluded.rows_json
mapper.select: SELECT note, hours, timed_seconds FROM yunxiao_quick_effort_receipt WHERE scope = #{binding.scope} AND child_id = #{binding.childId} AND day = #{day}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO yunxiao_quick_effort_receipt (scope, child_id, day, note, hours, timed_seconds) VALUES (#{binding.scope}, #{binding.childId}, #{day}, #{receipt.note}, #{receipt.hours}, #{receipt.timedSeconds}) ON CONFLICT (scope, child_id, day) DO UPDATE SET note = excluded.note, hours = excluded.hours, timed_seconds = excluded.timed_seconds
mapper.update: UPDATE yunxiao_quick_effort_receipt SET hours = NULL WHERE scope = #{binding.scope} AND child_id = #{binding.childId} AND day = #{day}
mapper.select: SELECT task_id FROM yunxiao_timer_task WHERE scope = #{scope} AND parent_id = #{parentId} AND display_title = #{title}
INSERT INTO task (title) VALUES (#{key}) RETURNING id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO yunxiao_timer_task (task_id, scope, parent_id, display_title) VALUES (#{taskId}, #{scope}, #{parentId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{title})
INSERT INTO yunxiao_auto_task (task_id, draft) VALUES (#{taskId}, #{draft}) ON CONFLICT (task_id) DO UPDATE SET draft = excluded.draft
mapper.sql: SELECT e.task_id, e.day, e.revision, t.display_title FROM yunxiao_auto_effort e JOIN yunxiao_timer_task t ON t.task_id = e.task_id
mapper.select: WHERE t.scope = #{scope} ORDER BY e.day, e.task_id
WHERE e.task_id = #{taskId} AND e.day = #{day}
JOIN yunxiao_binding b ON b.task_id = t.task_id AND b.scope = t.scope WHERE b.scope = #{binding.scope} AND b.child_id = #{binding.childId} AND e.day = #{day}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM yunxiao_auto_effort
SELECT task_id FROM yunxiao_auto_effort WHERE day = #{day}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM yunxiao_auto_effort WHERE task_id = #{effort.taskId} AND day = #{effort.day} AND revision = #{effort.revision}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO yunxiao_binding (task_id, scope, child_id, label) VALUES (#{taskId}, #{binding.scope}, #{binding.childId}, #{binding.label}) ON CONFLICT (task_id) DO UPDATE SET label = excluded.label WHERE yunxiao_binding.scope = excluded.scope AND yunxiao_binding.child_id = excluded.child_id
mapper.select: SELECT marker, remote_id, 0 AS fresh FROM yunxiao_write WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND scope = #{scope} AND operation = #{operation}

INSERT INTO yunxiao_write (task_id, scope, operation, marker) VALUES (#{taskId}, #{scope}, #{operation}, #{marker}) ON CONFLICT (task_id, scope, operation) DO UPDATE SET marker = yunxiao_write.marker RETURNING marker, remote_id, marker = #{marker} AS fresh
mapper.update: UPDATE yunxiao_write SET remote_id = #{remoteId} WHERE marker = #{marker}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM yunxiao_write WHERE marker = #{marker} AND remote_id = ''
